note: Spec paths, blobs, enum values and events the azure adapter does not map, with why. Checked by TestSpecCoverage (internal/providers/contractspec). Gap IDs are the azure contract tests' (testdata/contracts/*/meta.json); O* IDs are the openai adapter's, whose canonical types this adapter decodes into too.

unmapped.reason: known gap A1: Azure's per-choice content filter verdicts (category, severity, filtered, protected material) are dropped; models.Choice has no field for them and no Extra, so a client cannot see why a completion was cut to finish_reason "content_filter"
known gap A2: Azure On Your Data's message.context (citations, intent) is dropped, so answers grounded on data_sources reach the client with [docN] markers and no citations

known gap O32: the legacy function_call (deprecated functions parameter) is dropped; the canonical message has only tool_calls (the adapter decodes into the same canonical types as the openai adapter)
known gap O1: message.refusal is dropped (models.Message has no refusal field); a structured-outputs refusal reaches the client as content null with no explanation
known gap O32: the legacy function_call (deprecated functions parameter) is dropped; the canonical delta has only tool_calls
known gap O2: delta.refusal is dropped (models.Delta has no refusal field), so a streamed refusal reaches the client as empty deltas
known gap O3: streamed choice logprobs are dropped (models.StreamChoice has no logprobs field), so a stream with logprobs: true carries none to the client

known gap A4: a content-filter rejection's inner error (code ResponsibleAIPolicyViolation and the per-category verdicts) is dropped; parseProviderError keeps message, type and code, so the client cannot tell which category blocked the prompt. The spec spells it inner_error / content_filter_results; the live service sends innererror / content_filter_result (contract case error_content_filter), dropped all the same
known gap A3: each image's content filter verdicts are dropped; models.ImageData has no field for them and models.ImageResponse no Extra, so a client cannot see why an image was filtered
known gap A3: each image's prompt filter verdicts (including jailbreak and profanity) are dropped, as content_filter_results

known gap A9: the audio duration Azure reports (and bills by) reaches the client in the passed-through body but is not read: the gateway prices a transcription from the length of the uploaded WAV, so a non-WAV upload is unpriced although the upstream says how long it was
